source_review.notes: Checked all ten final official references on 2026-08-31. The six NASA pages/directives and current GAO-25-106454 HTML returned HTTP 200 directly. The two DAU-hosted PDFs and GAO-21-68 official page were reviewed through official indexed text, while direct curl requests from this environment returned HTTP 403. The chapter reports no false all-200 claim. DoD independence definitions and governance types are used diagnostically; NASA authority/change guidance is tailored to a federated context; GAO findings remain bounded audit cases.

evidence: Reviewed operational independence OI(c,q,k,t) as useful detached behavior for a mission-external context and stakeholder.
Reviewed managerial independence MI(c,d,t) as retained legitimate and practical decision power by domain and time.
Reviewed feasible-action subset over directed, agreed, and incentivized actions without treating publication as authority.
Reviewed independence-profile and constituent-obligation tuples with explicit dependencies, evidence, effectivity, change, exception, and uncertainty.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation prevents one permanent binary independence label and separates usefulness, authority, context, evidence, and time.

evidence: Executed constituent-independence-ledger-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-092/report.json.
Confirmed five declared constituents, four OI declarations, four MI declarations, and three intersections.
Confirmed two central-directive declarations, four local-release declarations, and one unowned cross-boundary obligation.
Confirmed the fixture rejects the metadata gate until the critical obligation receives an accepted owner.
Reviewed Exercise 2 and confirmed that six unlike decision domains cannot be meaningfully summarized as 67 percent independent or 33 percent centrally controlled without a justified decision model.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts are ledger consistency evidence only and do not validate usefulness, authority, funding, lawful control, competence, execution, or mission outcome.

evidence: Confirmed detached power-on, technical isolation, or organizational naming does not entail useful operational independence.
Confirmed legal ownership, separate budget, vendor count, charter language, or RACI labels do not entail managerial authority in every decision domain.
Confirmed accountability for an end-to-end outcome does not entail directive reach, funding, information, or enforcement.
Confirmed a published requirement or signed agreement does not entail accepted, resourced, feasible, and fulfilled constituent behavior.
Confirmed local independence does not entail freedom from law, safety/security, shared hazards, contracts, or agreed mission obligations.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter distinguishes formal, practical, and shadow authority and rejects invalid implications from documents or labels to control.

evidence: Challenged partial detached modes, stale credentials/data/policy, dedicated enablers, hidden platform dependencies, common cloud/identity, and independent recovery/reconnection.
Challenged authority split across proposal, approval, veto, funding, implementation, operations, evidence, risk acceptance, and escalation.
Challenged unlawful data requests, sovereign constraints, unfunded work, one-sided benefits, local priority conflicts, shadow platform veto, and supplier leverage.
Challenged refusal, missed funding, withdrawal, acquisition, vendor change, emergency centralization, local bypass, substitution, interface drift, and evidence expiry.
Reviewed ten examples and five complete answers for concrete authority mechanisms, contrary evidence, assumptions, local/global effects, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: External assessment needs competent constituent owners, operators, funders, legal/regulatory and data authorities, systems/interface/configuration experts, safety/security/privacy authorities, V&V, and legitimate SoS governance.

evidence: Confirmed OI claims name detached stakeholder, useful service, context, threshold, dependencies, evidence, and limitations.
Confirmed MI claims are mapped per decision domain to formal and practical mechanisms and sampled actual decisions.
Confirmed every critical shared obligation requires authorized acceptance, resources, evidence, effectivity, notice/change, exception, and exit.
Confirmed local mission, law, safety, security, privacy, service, support, and capacity are noncompensable constraints where applicable.
Confirmed governance mechanisms match actual directive reach and address funding, escalation, emergency action, withdrawal, and federated change.
Confirmed material authority, ownership, platform, funding, regulatory, supplier, dependency, or operating changes trigger reassessment.
invariant_checking.notes: No chart, title, signature, standard, central platform, separate team, separate budget, or committee is treated as sufficient authority or independence evidence alone.

proof_review.notes: No formal theorem or proof is claimed; feasible-action and independence expressions are bounded governance models.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled synthetic_independence_ledger_consistent and declared_metadata_only.
The fixture disclaims actual usefulness, authority, funding, lawful control, competence, behavior, evidence truth, and mission outcomes.
GAO findings are attributed as bounded public audit cases and not generalized into a universal causal law.
Examples and exercises are synthetic teaching cases, not actual authority delegations, contracts, legal opinions, operational approvals, or readiness findings.
Official sources are attributed without claiming external review, approval, or endorsement.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Declared metadata, sampled decisions, documentary authority, observed behavior, source-backed guidance, internal review, and competent external authorization remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked contextual OI, decision-vector MI, formal/practical/shadow authority, accountability gaps, bilateral obligations, local viability, directive reach, forums, federated requirements/configuration, change, data authority, withdrawal, emergencies, central dependence, incentives, verification, and bounded conclusions.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked charters, contracts, budgets, credentials, boards, interface ownership, data control, version/effectivity, notices, compatibility, reference tests, incidents, emergency modes, substitutions, acquisitions, support funding, offline operation, re-entry, and observed decision traces.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from independence diagnosis through authority mapping, obligation design, federated operation, verification, and transfer. Ten examples and five answers cover enablers, partial OI, weak boards, lawful refusal, semantic change, incentives, emergency powers, acquisition, compatibility funding, shadow authority, weather services, governance gaps, alerts, and open-source supply chains.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external DoD, Air Force, DAU, GAO, NASA, constituent owner/operator, funder, systems/domain engineer, interface/configuration/data authority, safety/security/privacy authority, legal/regulatory authority, contracting authority, V&V authority, customer, auditor, academic, or other practitioner review is claimed.
